title: In a Sweltering Summer, These Italians Want Romans to Curl
summary_full: By setting up a curling rink in the shadow of the Colosseum, sports officials hope to capitalize on the fresh popularity of the Winter Olympics phenomenon. Even in a heat wave and without any ice.
